name: Facet
text: Choose a light theme as the default for Excava’s interface. It maximizes visibility and clarity for most users in typical work environments, reducing eye strain during long sessions. Trade-off: we accept lower contrast in bright rooms compared to dark themes, but the manual dark-mode toggle keeps the option flexible. This balances immediate readability with user control.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A light theme fails in mixed lighting—glare from windows or screens forces users to squint or toggle manually mid-session, breaking flow. Dark theme with auto-brightness (not manual) avoids flicker while preserving visibility; test it under real lighting conditions to settle.
